name: application-hashtag-trend-list
title: Hashtag Trend List
description: Ranked list of trending hashtags with category and a human-readable post-count label (e.g. "24.3K posts") — distinct from leaderboard-list, which ranks people/scores rather than topics.
useWhen: Showing what's trending on a social platform, ranked by post volume.
You want the K/M post-count abbreviation computed from a real number, not typed per row.
Each trend needs a category label alongside the tag itself.
avoidWhen: You're ranking people or scores, not topics — use leaderboard-list instead.
You need per-hashtag charts or historical trend lines — pair this list with a chart component instead.
The list isn't ranked (no meaningful order) — use a plain tag list or tag-filter-group instead.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are a single flex line with truncating hashtag text; the list itself scrolls in its own container if it exceeds available height.
accessibility: The list is a real ordered list (<ol>) so assistive tech announces each trend's rank position and total count.
Post counts are always shown as real text (e.g. "1.2M posts"), never implied by rank position alone.
Category text sits directly under each hashtag, keeping the two pieces of context associated for screen readers reading in order.

variants.title: Hashtag trend list
variants.description: Five ranked trending hashtags spanning 1.2M down to 640 posts, with category labels, on a light surface.
accessibility: Post-count formatting switches between raw/K/M based on the real magnitude, matching common social-platform conventions.

variants.title: Hashtag trend list (Dark)
variants.description: The same five trending hashtags, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Rank, hashtag, and category text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
